format: JavaScript (TypeScript with .mjs extensions, using ES modules)
description: This file is a script designed to analyze a codebase for specific architecture-related 'smells' or problematic patterns. It scans TypeScript files in designated source directories, looking for issues such as extension facade re-exports, runtime type implementation references, and runtime service locator patterns. The script collects entries related to these issues and outputs a report, either in human-readable format or as JSON.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Function used to sort collected report entries based on category, file, line, kind, specifier, and reason.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Utility to add a new report entry to the entries array.

methods.name: scanPluginSdkExtensionFacadeSmells
methods.description: Scans a source file for extension facade re-export patterns indicative of architecture smells within the plugin SDK directory.

methods.name: scanRuntimeTypeImplementationSmells
methods.description: Analyzes source files matching runtime type implementation paths for import-type references that may signify architecture issues.

methods.name: scanRuntimeServiceLocatorSmells
methods.description: Inspects source files for patterns related to runtime service locator and mutable state access functions that could indicate architectural concerns.

methods.name: collectArchitectureSmells
methods.description: Collections orchestrator that gathers all smell entries from relevant source files.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the collected architecture smell entries into a human-readable string report.

methods.name: runArchitectureSmellsCheck
methods.description: Main function to run the architecture smell scan, outputting results to specified streams, in JSON or human format based on arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that executes the architecture smell check, defaulting to process arguments.
